title: Reoccurring School in a Mall
content: Hi, first time poster, I actually just found this sub. I can’t exactly place when this started but for the past few years, maybe longer, I have had many many dreams take place in a school connected to a mall. The dream never starts there but for some reason, all my dreams have been ending there. In the one I had last night, I had to banish a demon through a board game and was in a market-type store. I guess I just want to understand why this place comes up so frequently and why my dreams seem to always end here.
